title: 44% off Disney+ Standard $9.99/mth for 3 Months (New & Eligible Returning Subscribers, $17.99/mth Thereafter) @ Disney Plus
body:
Deal: 44% off Disney+ Standard $9.99/mth for 3 Months (New & Eligible Returning Subscribers, $17.99/mth Thereafter) @ Disney Plus

[Aftos] Worked for me. $10/month is my baseline, so I jumped on it
[ictsol] Similar savings when you try to cancel your existing month-to-month subscription: $13.99 for 6 month, then 17.99 again.
[kerfuffle] Thanks for this tip; got mine for $13.49
[IRON] Kids watch Disney movies. I watch NBA games.
[PhoenixIsRight] I signed back up a couple months ago to watch Rental Family with Brendan Fraser. Watched some documentaries and currently going through Scrubs. Will quit again once that’s done.
[FujinShu] New Kingdom Hearts series is happening soon there.
[Urabawbag] Can't share with friends anymore. That's enough for me. I'll just purchase it for a month when there is something worth watching on it.
[Iwantthebestprice] Has Disney followed Netflix and blocked sharing accounts?
[mahdoo] $10/month is way too much for 1080p streams.
I'd pay maybe $7/month for 4k.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] thanks will consider. have to look up the added to disney watchlist on apple tv app.
but I only sub during these promotion so thanks.
[daffyd] Not sure how many ads but the ad-supported version is the same price usually. So can swap down if using it regularly but don't want to pay the usual monthly
[TruckTrespass] I currently have a Disney+ account, but this will be the last year. Amazon Prime isn't getting renewed either. After that it'll just be indian Apple TV (leftover gift cards from Netflix)
[Alwaysagooner] does anyone know when is the end date? Cheers
[Dyl] For those who stay in hotels often, Accor signature you get reward points basically equal to the value of it to spend on stays and it includes free Disney+, HBO Max or a few others (only one).
I cancelled my signature like 2 months ago and my HBO Max is still active through them.
[bodysurfer] Where do you find this please? In the ALL Accor app or is it part of Accor plus, or when you stay at a hotel you access it somehow? Thanks.
[DealHunted] Good timing! Should last almost until the school holidays end!
[Don5252] Is this the ad free level? I wouldn’t mind it for some of the music documentaries. Cheers.
[31mop] Doesn’t work for us. Just keep getting errors
[QuickToThePointless] anyone just use disney+ for ESPN?
kayo gotten pretty steep…anyone using this as an alternative over summer months?
[NinjaChicken] Not just ESPN, but I do use it for ESPN - unless you are sailing the 7 seas, you aren't going to get more comprehensive coverage of NHL, NBA, MLB, NBL, etc…
There's also the possibility that in the near future they will have the rights to the F1.
So while 'Ol Walt is expensive, there is a value proposition there - especially with kids who love the Disney content…
[QuickToThePointless] yeah NBA/NBL is what im interested in…dont care much about marvel star wars anything else etc they offer TBH
$10pm seems pretty good - kayo is now $30pm min. montlhy.
can share for around $15pm but that requires pre paid commitment to a full 12 months of ~$350 for 2 screens.
[Cheepcheepcheep] Disney + for espn is worth it if you care about American sports. But no value for me.
[silverham] Where the terms and conditions for the promotion? It sems Disney+ standard with ads has $9.99 as the normal monthly price??
[Round Noodle] For anyone who has subscribed via this offer, is there an option to upgrade to premium (4K) for a discounted price?
[mrshorty] doesnt look like it - when i go to accounts, it says
Disney+ Premium
$24.99/month
Movies and series, plus sports from ESPN. Up to 4K UHD & HDR and up to Dolby Atmos audio. 4 concurrent streams. Ad-free movies and series^. Downloads on up to 10 devices.
[mrshorty] Thanks OP - next 3 months of some NBA and NFL sorted!
